Game Overview

At its heart, Cheese Moon is a simulation game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Cheese Moon doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Cheese Moon?

Cheese Moon is a free simulation game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Cheese Moon free to play?

Yes, Cheese Moon is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
